paths.head: Action · CTV view-through and mobile click-through
steps: Ad plays on the TV or phone. Household IP or device ID is logged
Someone in the home visits the vet finder or brand page

Visits matched to exposure and compared with the 10% holdout

steps: Exposed households are connected to the household graph
Short survey served to exposed homes and a matched control
Awareness and intent to ask the vet, by audience

slides.side:
Adult ticks are active through the fall, so pet owners are in market right now.

We think the fastest way to prove the graph to Merck is a clean Animal Health read. Then the Human Health deals follow on the same seats.

slides.title: Pharma guardrails
slides.kicker: What we see, what we don't, and what we won't do
slides.footnote: Source: Sabio Internal FAQ and CTV FAQ, 2026. Data management documentation available on request. All Human Health targeting subject to Merck MLR review.

cells.head: What we observe
cells.body: Which apps are installed and how recently they're used. Never what anyone reads or types inside a health app.

cells.head: No condition inference
cells.body: We don't build audiences that imply a person's diagnosis. HCP and care-manager signals only, unless Merck MLR approves more.

cells.head: What leaves Sabio
cells.body: No device IDs. Reporting is aggregated by age, demo and geo. CCPA compliant, and every opt-out is honored.

cells.head: iOS signal
cells.body: Apple's restrictions mean most app data comes from Android. We show the iOS share on each build.

cells.head: Merck 1P
cells.body: HCP lists or NPI files can be layered in through a clean room, on Merck's terms.

cells.head: Brand safety
cells.body: DoubleVerify on all supply, TAG registered, US only. Block and allow lists accepted.
